id: 02_How to flush an eyewash station Demonstration at ATRB
title: 洗眼器的定期冲洗
source_doc: course/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/02_How to flush an eyewash station Demonstration at ATRB.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Equipment Safety Series/02_How to flush an eyewash station Demonstration at ATRB/src.py

points.K1: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗
points.K2: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
points.S2: 记住位置，保持通道畅通
points.S4: 登记检查卡，发现问题报修
points.S5: 眼睛溅入化学品怎么冲

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室墙边的洗眼器旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a wall-mounted lab eyewash station with an eyewash sign above it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天学习洗眼器怎样定期冲洗。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着墙上的不锈钢洗眼柜，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks curiously at a recessed stainless steel eyewash cabinet built into the wall, with an eyewash sign above it.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：洗眼器平时又不用，为啥要放水？

shots.scene: 小研提着一只蓝色水桶和一卷软管走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over carrying a blue plastic water can with a black flexible hose attached.
shots.narration: 小研说：今天轮到我冲洗，一起来看看。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗
shots.scene: 嵌墙柜：左边灭火器箱，右边洗眼柜，上方有标识
shots.prompt_en: A recessed stainless steel wall cabinet with a fire extinguisher compartment on the left and an eyewash cabinet on the right, an eyewash sign and a safety shower sign above it. No people.
shots.narration: 这是嵌在墙里的喷淋洗眼柜。
overlay: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗

shots.section_title: 洗眼器要定期放水冲洗
shots.scene: 柜门把手上挂着一张空白检查卡
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a blank inspection tag hanging on the handle of the stainless steel eyewash cabinet door. No people.
shots.narration: 柜门上挂着检查卡，要定期冲洗。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
shots.scene: 柜体底部的小排水口特写，下面没有接水盆
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a small drain outlet at the bottom panel of the recessed cabinet, with no basin below it, only the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 这种柜子底下只有排水口，没有水盆。
overlay: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
shots.scene: 软管、柔性接头和蓝色水桶三个部件，箭头连成一套
shots.prompt_en: Three parts linked by arrows into one setup: a black corrugated hose, a short rubber flexible coupling and a blue plastic water can with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 要先备好引流软管、接头和水桶。

shots.section_title: 嵌墙式洗眼柜：先备引流装置
shots.scene: 水桶贴着一张写有图标的专用标签
shots.prompt_en: A blue plastic water can with a blank label showing only an eyewash pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 水桶标明洗眼器冲洗专用。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀、引流装置和一叠纸巾摆在地上
shots.prompt_en: A flathead screwdriver, the hose-and-can drainage setup and a stack of paper towels laid out on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 还要一把一字螺丝刀和一叠纸巾。

shots.scene: 小研蹲下，把柔性接头套在排水口上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat and gloves, crouches and fits a rubber flexible coupling onto the drain outlet of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 把柔性接头套在排水口上。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀拧紧接头上的卡箍特写
shots.prompt_en: A close view of a flathead screwdriver tightening the metal hose clamp on the rubber coupling. No people.
shots.narration: 用螺丝刀把卡箍拧紧，防止漏水。

shots.scene: 软管另一头插进水桶口
shots.prompt_en: The other end of the black hose goes into the opening of the blue water can on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 软管另一头接进水桶。

shots.scene: 水桶平放在柜前地面，旁边放着纸巾
shots.prompt_en: The blue water can stands steady on the floor in front of the cabinet, with paper towels placed beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 水桶放平放稳，纸巾放在手边。

shots.scene: 小研打开洗眼柜，水流进排水口
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the eyewash cabinet and activates it; water flows down into the drain and through the hose into the can.
shots.narration: 按本单位的方法启动洗眼器放水。

shots.scene: 水沿软管流进水桶的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram with blue arrows showing water flowing from the cabinet drain through the hose into the can. No people.
shots.narration: 水经排水口和软管，流进水桶。

shots.scene: 小研关闭洗眼器后站在一旁等待，旁边沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the eyewash and waits beside it, with an hourglass icon floating nearby.
shots.narration: 关水后等几分钟，让水完全排净。

shots.scene: 急着拔软管的手图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand pulling the hose off the drain while water still drips, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 水没排完就拆，会洒一地。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾托在接头下方，慢慢拆下接头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a paper towel under the coupling and slowly removes it from the drain.
shots.narration: 拆接头时，用纸巾接住滴水。

shots.scene: 地面湿滑警告标志和滑倒的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A general warning triangle next to a pictogram of a person slipping on a wet floor. No people.
shots.narration: 地上有水容易滑倒。

shots.scene: 小研蹲下用纸巾擦干地面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student crouches and wipes the wet floor dry with paper towels.
shots.narration: 洒出来的水，马上擦干。

shots.scene: 小研提着水桶走到实验室水槽边
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the blue water can to a lab sink.
shots.narration: 把水桶提到水槽边。

shots.scene: 水从水桶经软管倒进水槽
shots.prompt_en: Water pours from the tilted can through the hose into a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 把冲洗出的水倒进水槽，收好装置。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着管道剖面示意，里面有积水和沉淀
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a cutaway diagram of a pipe with still stagnant water and sediment particles inside.
shots.narration: 水管里的水停久了，会变脏。

shots.scene: 清澈的水流冲过管道，脏物被带走
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of the same pipe with clear water flowing through and carrying the sediment away. No people.
shots.narration: 定期放水，冲掉积水和沉积物。

shots.scene: 日历图标旁边是洗眼器图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to an eyewash station icon with a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 多久冲一次，按标准和学校规定。

shots.section_title: 记住位置，保持通道畅通
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和喷淋标志挂在设备上方
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign and a safety shower sign mounted above an emergency shower and eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室，先记住洗眼器在哪儿。
overlay: 记住位置，保持通道畅通

shots.section_title: 记住位置，保持通道畅通
shots.scene: 洗眼器前堆着纸箱的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of cardboard boxes piled in front of an eyewash station, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前面不能堆东西，通道要畅通。

shots.scene: 小研观察两股水流从洗眼喷头柔和涌出
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches two gentle water streams rising from the eyewash nozzles.
shots.narration: 冲洗时，顺便检查出水情况。

shots.scene: 四个检查项图标逐一打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each getting a green check: a water drop, two parallel streams, a clear glass of water and a nozzle dust cap. No people.
shots.narration: 出水及时、水流柔和、水质清澈。

shots.section_title: 登记检查卡，发现问题报修
shots.scene: 小研在空白检查卡上签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student signs a blank inspection tag on the eyewash cabinet door.
shots.narration: 冲洗完，在检查卡上登记签名。
overlay: 登记检查卡，发现问题报修

shots.section_title: 登记检查卡，发现问题报修
shots.scene: 小研打电话，老李拿着工具走来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call while the facility engineer walks over carrying a toolbox.
shots.narration: 出水异常，及时报修，挂牌提醒。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入化学品怎么冲
shots.scene: 欣欣举着洗眼器标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an eyewash sign.
shots.narration: 万一化学品溅进眼睛，马上冲。
overlay: 眼睛溅入化学品怎么冲

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入化学品怎么冲
shots.scene: 阿杰俯身在洗眼器前，双手撑开眼睑冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over an eyewash station and holds his eyelids open with his fingers while water rinses his eyes.
shots.narration: 用手撑开眼睑，让水冲到眼球。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入化学品怎么冲
shots.scene: 转动的眼球示意和沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple eye icon with circular arrows showing the eye rolling, next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 转动眼球，持续冲洗足够长时间。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入化学品怎么冲
shots.scene: 隐形眼镜图标和取出箭头
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a contact lens with an arrow showing it being removed. No people.
shots.narration: 戴隐形眼镜的，冲洗中尽快取下。

shots.section_title: 眼睛溅入化学品怎么冲
shots.scene: 小研扶着阿杰的肩膀帮他冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student supports the young male student's shoulder while he rinses his eyes at the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 同伴协助冲洗，并呼叫帮助。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗后尽快就医，紧急拨打120。

shots.scene: 空白化学品标签被带去医院的示意
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank chemical bottle label next to a hospital icon with an arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 就医时说明溅入的是什么化学品。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man at the lab doorway; he listens and nods.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人和学院。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现软管、水桶和螺丝刀图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a hose, a water can and a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 接好引流，拧紧卡箍，水桶放稳。

shots.scene: 沙漏、纸巾和水槽三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: an hourglass, paper towels and a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 等水排净，擦干地面，倒进水槽。

shots.scene: 检查卡和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank inspection tag and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 定期冲洗，检查出水，登记签名。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和撑开眼睑冲洗的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign next to a pictogram of a person rinsing open eyes. No people.
shots.narration: 溅入眼睛，立即冲洗，就医报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在洗眼器旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a clean wall-mounted eyewash station.
shots.narration: 洗眼器常检查，用时才靠得住！
